description: In our current political environment, there are many challenges. To be a legislator today you have to have common sense, be knowledgeable, have ethics and be calm under stress. The candidate for the 37th House District, Anne Santoro, has all of these characteristics. Anne has served East Lyme as an elected official and community member with distinction, and she will do the same for the 37th District.
